title: C: Boolean Logic
description: Use logical operators (&&, ||, !) to evaluate boolean expressions and print the results.

steps.title: Logical Expressions
steps.description: Declare `int a = 1, b = 0` (1 for true, 0 for false). Compute and print: a && b, a || b, !a, !b. Label each output.
hints: In C, 0 is false, any non-zero is true.
`&&` is AND, `||` is OR, `!` is NOT.
Use `%d` to print the integer result (1 or 0).

verification.failureMessage: Print the results of a&&b, a||b, !a, !b
